## 2026-05-14 22:00 UTC — [Pillar 3] RANGE/UP breakout branch is promising only as a 30m paper candidate

**Task:** Follow P3 by checking HL exposure, diagnosing why `hl_local_range_trend_v0` stopped adding rows, and building a current-regime audit for today’s notional-blocked/pass-filter HL signals.
**Finding:** Bots are alive (`212942.pm-bot`, `153703.hl-bot`). HL wallet has **$37.391639 USDC** and **no open positions**, so there was nothing to resize or close. `hl_local_range_trend_v0` remains frozen at **38 rows** with **0 new qualifying rows** and **0 pending maturities** because the scorer requires `local_regime=RANGE` inside `market_regime=STRONG_TREND`, while today’s active HL tape is mostly **market RANGE/UP**. Source health is otherwise understandable: paper file age was **165.5m**, live state/log were fresh, last cycle showed **Signals: 0**, and the account is still in **notional_blocked** mode (planned **$11.217492** vs min order **$20**). I added `scripts/analyze_hl_range_up_breakout_v0.py` to audit the current RANGE/UP regime without changing live behavior. Across **333** mature pass-filter rows, generic RANGE/UP longs are not clean (**n=63 / 15m WR 47.6% / +12.09bp; 30m WR 50.8% / +10.81bp; 60m WR 41.3% / +6.09bp**). The sharper current candidate is RANGE/UP + local TREND/STRONG_TREND longs: all mature **n=29 / 15m WR 62.1% / +27.49bp; 30m WR 58.6% / +17.74bp**, but **60m is hostile** (**WR 27.6% / -19.04bp**). Today-only evidence is better but thin: **n=11 / 15m WR 63.6% / +43.88bp; 30m WR 63.6% / +46.99bp; 60m WR 54.5% / +26.15bp**. RANGE shorts are rejected for today (**n=11 / 30m WR 27.3% / -16.27bp**). Artifact written to `research/p3-range-up-breakout-audit-2026-05-14-2200.json`; validation passed with `python3 -m py_compile scripts/analyze_hl_range_up_breakout_v0.py`.
**My thinking:** The old P3 branch did not fail; the market regime rotated away from its collection domain. Today’s RANGE/UP tape says chasing every long is still too noisy, but local trend alignment may be capturing continuation bursts while the notional guard prevents live fills. The catch is sample size and horizon: the all-history 60m profile is bad, so this is a **30m max-hold research branch**, not a live permission slip.
**Decision:** No live HL trade and no promotion. Keep `hl_local_range_trend_v0` paper-only. Track `range_up_local_trend_long` as a separate P3 paper candidate with promotion floor **n>=35**, **30m WR >=62%**, **30m avg >=+12bp**, and **60m max-loss/worst-tail not worsening** before any guarded live design. Do not act on RANGE shorts here.
**Next:** On the next P3 pass, rerun `scripts/analyze_hl_range_up_breakout_v0.py` after more maturities; if `range_up_local_trend_long` reaches **n>=20** today/rolling with 30m WR still above **62%**, add a formal scorer/history file and an explicit max-hold/stop rule.
